# `tfctl auth`

The `tfctl auth` command provides subcommands for managing authentication with HCP Terraform.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl auth` command provides subcommands for managing authentication with HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise. Use these commands to log in and check your authentication status.

## Subcommands

- [`login`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/auth/login) - Authenticate with HCP Terraform
- [`status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/auth/status) - Check authentication status
